actual: The approved REFIT-02-A controlled diagnostic executes the 19D treatment and positive harness but intentionally stops the matched current-A5 20D control after successful initialization. Post-BUG-975 current initialization no longer reproduces the historical blocker, so the diagnostic deterministically returns diagnostic_failed/inconclusive without observing the matched 20D HMM outcome. The contract must compare current-A5 matched 20D and 19D under the same frozen inputs, seed schedule, numeric environment and D3/D4 descriptive evidence while retaining historical blocker evidence as reference only; no D5/D6, seed selection, model/READY, DB or runtime mutation.
